Prescription flow only
backlog.recommendation: Keep both; the free treatment stays in Health record and Treat is retired.

backlog.title: How does a prescription relate to per-pig treatment?
backlog.detail: 28 screens in nine groups (2025.9) with scan, skip dose and abnormality states; the largest unbuilt flow. Overlaps Data sync (waiting treatments) and the open Home card question.
options: Prescriptions are plans that create treatment records
Separate record types
backlog.recommendation: Plans that create the same treatment record; decide the Home card first.

backlog.title: Death is drawn in three places
backlog.detail: Farrowing's death sheet, Piglet processing's Record death and this Inspection flow (10 screens) each record death. Which is the shared form and how does it count against batches?
options: One death form with piglet and sow variants
Keep each local
backlog.recommendation: One death form; entry points differ only by preset.

backlog.title: Miscarriage built in Pig profile vs Abortion placeholder
backlog.detail: Pig profile already builds Record miscarriage and Farrowing's outcomes use it; this feature repeats it as three placeholder screens (6 in Figma). Same event, two names.
options: Retire Abortion; miscarriage is the form
Rename the built form to Abortion
backlog.recommendation: Retire Abortion; keep the built Record miscarriage.

backlog.title: Retire Record farrowing in favour of the Farrowing task?
backlog.detail: Farrowing is built with counting, finish and edit. Record farrowing (8 old screens) is the pig-door duplicate, including preconditions and 'join batch'.
options: Pig action opens the Farrowing sheet
Keep as a separate quick form
backlog.recommendation: Pig action opens the Farrowing sheet; keep only join-batch.

backlog.title: Fostering vs Piglet processing 'Move piglets'
backlog.detail: Piglet processing builds Move piglets within a batch; fostering moves between sows and across stages. Is fostering a move, or its own event with parentage?
options: Fostering is Move piglets with a receiving sow
Own event
backlog.recommendation: Fostering is Move piglets with a receiving sow.

backlog.title: Blocked states of the Heat form are not ruled
backlog.detail: The old file draws bred and pregnant pigs as separate states; the section says the sow's state decides what is available, and the form is shared with Heat check.
options: Blocked with the reason
Allow with a warning
backlog.recommendation: Blocked with the reason, as the section text says.

backlog.title: Where is Mark as breeder done?
backlog.detail: Piglet processing marks breeders inline; the Weaning task has 'Keep breeders and fill IDs'; this file has 13 screens plus a No-ID variant. Three doors, three forms.
options: One form, three doors
Only at weaning
backlog.recommendation: One form, three doors.

backlog.title: Line and batch choice repeats Abortion and Heat
backlog.detail: Production line and batch search appear in three events; design the shared line and batch picker once and reuse it.

backlog.title: Wean duplicates the Weaning check task
backlog.detail: The same check and piglet information as the task. The blocked state (farrowing not finished) is a rule shared with Farrowing.
options: Block with the reason
Offer to finish farrowing first
backlog.recommendation: Block with the reason.

backlog.title: One-pig measure already built in Pig profile
backlog.detail: Pig profile's Record weight, temperature or backfat takes one reading per pig; this placeholder duplicates that form.

backlog.title: Weight appears as pig reading, litter weight and task check
backlog.detail: Individual weight, Piglet litter weight and the weaning check each weigh. The old file hides weight in the backfat group.
options: One weight form with a pig or litter target
Keep separate
backlog.recommendation: One weight form with a pig or litter target.

backlog.title: One-pig measure already built in Pig profile
backlog.detail: Same as Backfat: a duplicate of the built reading form; retire or link.

backlog.title: Move vs batch membership and Piglet 'Move piglets'
backlog.detail: Old Move picks a location for many pigs; Pig profile builds batch membership (batch, not place) and Piglet processing moves piglets between pens. Which events are place moves?
options: One Move form for place; batch changes stay separate
Merge with batch membership
backlog.recommendation: One Move form for place; batch changes stay separate.

backlog.title: Single confirm screen; needs reason and effect
backlog.detail: One screen in Figma. No reason, date or batch effect is specified, and blocked pigs are not described.

backlog.title: Sampling section text is 'Not written yet'
backlog.detail: No shared rules for how rooms, sample types (mixed, pig, person, supply, environment) and result states (waiting, negative, positive) relate. The English and Chinese Figma sections differ.

backlog.title: Sync section text is 'Not written yet'
backlog.detail: No shared rules for what syncs, conflict handling or how it relates to Home's Saved work drawer.

backlog.title: Which Figma section is the reference: Chinese or English V2.0?
backlog.detail: The English one is shorter and uses different screens. Sampling also needs an owner and a Home entrance.
options: Chinese
English
Merge
backlog.recommendation: Chinese, the fuller one.

backlog.title: Is Data sync a page or part of the Saved-work drawer?
backlog.detail: 17 old screens (2025.4): entry banner, list, per-pig and per-treatment detail with conflict and empty states, and upload. Home already has a drawer. Treatment sync is tied to Prescriptions.
options: Drawer is the list; detail is a sheet
Separate page
backlog.recommendation: Drawer is the list, detail a sheet.

backlog.title: Adjust feed screen opens the walk list, not the editor
backlog.detail: Bare and in the atlas phone, feed-plan.editor has no preset or steps, so it renders the plain walk. The most important feed screen cannot be reviewed.

backlog.title: End date and note screen opens the walk list
backlog.detail: No preset or steps on this screen, so it renders the unit walk. The date and note form that the notes describe is not shown.

backlog.title: Pig feed plan screen opens the walk list
backlog.detail: No preset or steps; the page that should show the Feeding block and Base curve renders the walk instead.

backlog.title: Boar and piglet rows are off-screen when opened
backlog.detail: The screen should show boars and piglets but opens at the top (C1 sow rows); the B1 and P1 pens sit far below the fold, so its point is not visible.

backlog.title: Hospital-care tag is not in view on the care-levels screen
backlog.detail: The notes point at Diarrhoea on 000801 with Move to hospital pen, but the screen opens at the top; that row is below the fold, so the four care levels are not seen together.

backlog.title: Sow 000306 reads 'Gestation · 40 days' here, '—' on the walk
backlog.detail: The record header shows 40 days, but the walk and pig-profile.empty show 'Gestation · —' (no stage start). Same pig, two stage readings.

backlog.title: Pen header counts and feed total ignore the active filter
backlog.detail: The count '3 pigs' and the kg total cover all pigs while rows show only filtered pigs. The total does not match the rows a worker sees.

backlog.title: Plural not handled: '1 days', '1 days old', '1 days ago'
backlog.detail: An ongoing condition on day 1 reads '1 days'; pig-profile Age and Last service repeat the fault. Needs a plural rule in the copy.

backlog.title: Check-in author and times are fixed text (G. Hansen, 06:40, 09:41)
backlog.detail: 'Last check-in', the walk log and the confirmation use constants, not the signed-in worker and real times. A developer cannot tell what is real.

backlog.title: An open equipment fault has no sign on the list
backlog.detail: The screen should show a pen with a note and a fault, but it renders like the walk: no fault mark exists, and the fault shows only in the pen log after it is reported.

backlog.title: Pen peek has a fault line that is never filled
backlog.detail: The preview carries a fault line in code but nothing feeds it. A pen of unknown feeding mode also reads 'Ad-lib' in the peek feed line.

backlog.title: Finding day count is stored as 1 and never advances
backlog.detail: 'Day N' is the urgency cue on rows and tags, but the prototype never increments it. Seeded findings also show 'Recorded — · —'.

backlog.title: Feed end date passes and nothing returns the pig to the curve
backlog.detail: The end date is a plain date; no rule restores the pig to the base curve when it passes, so the 'until' promise is empty.

backlog.title: Feed amounts show one decimal on rows, two in the editor
backlog.detail: A pig row reads 2.6 kg/day while the editor shows 2.64; the same number reads differently on two screens.

backlog.title: Search, review and scan show 'Gestating'; the row says 'Gestation'
backlog.detail: Find, Selected and Scan sheets use the raw stage word, the walk row uses stage and days. Same pig, two stage strings.

backlog.title: Weight, temperature and backfat accept any value above 0
backlog.detail: No upper bound or normal range; a typo of 1800 kg saves. In bulk, one invalid row blocks the whole save.

backlog.title: After a reading, the sheet drops to the walk, not the pig
backlog.detail: Reading, body condition and note forms return to the walk list; task, miscarriage and batch forms return to the record. One sheet family, two return rules.

backlog.title: Not in pig changes batch and stage with no confirmation or undo
backlog.detail: One tap among three equal choices removes the sow from her batch and sets her Off production / Open. A mis-tap cannot be recovered here.

backlog.title: Draw or delete the unit summary, sensors, batches and fault flows?
backlog.detail: 13 placeholder screens (sensors, batches, unit sheet, pen faults, report, resolve) exist only in code; no control reaches them. The Environment feature already owns sensors, maintenance and report-issue.
options: Delete all 13; Environment owns sensors and faults
Keep a one-line unit summary (pigs, pens, open faults) linking to Environment
Draw the full summary card, batch tracker and fault flow here
backlog.recommendation: Delete the sensor and fault screens (Environment covers them); keep at most a one-line unit summary with a link.

backlog.title: Is the batch tracker part of the walk?
backlog.detail: Batch tracker, batch sheet and batch filter are built but unreachable, and the filter has no field. The ROUND-3 carousel is gone. Tasks already organise work by batch.
options: Remove batch tracker and batch filter from Inspection
Place a batch row on the walk and enable the filter
Show batch only on the pig record
backlog.recommendation: Remove from Inspection; tasks and the pig record already carry batch.

backlog.title: Where does the pen head-count check live?
backlog.detail: The section text promises pen-count checks, but no Inspection screen exists. Research (pen-count.md) designs count correction as a pen-scoped event, with no screen in the atlas.
options: Add a pen count row to the pen sheet
Leave count correction to Fostering and Missing features
Drop the claim from the section text
backlog.recommendation: Add one row to the pen sheet that opens the pen count, so the text matches the product.

backlog.title: Default Care when recording a finding: No action needed or Monitor?
backlog.detail: The shortest path (choose Fever, Save) records a fever as an ongoing non-alert, so it never appears under needs attention.
options: Keep No action needed as default
Default to Monitor for all findings
Make Care a required choice with no default
backlog.recommendation: Make Care a required choice with no default, so a fever cannot silently become a non-alert.

backlog.title: Does 'Move to hospital pen' actually move the pig?
backlog.detail: Hospital pen is a care choice only: no pen change, no task, nothing. The label promises an action the app does not take.
options: Rename to 'Needs hospital pen' (a flag)
Open the Move flow from the care choice
Remove the level
backlog.recommendation: Rename it as a flag and link to Move from the finding, so the app does not imply a move that did not happen.

backlog.title: Should 'Entered in error' need a confirmation?
backlog.detail: Save outcome closes a finding as Entered in error with no second step, and also ends a linked feed adjustment. The log keeps the record but the active one is gone.
options: Keep one tap
Confirm line for Entered in error only
Undo for 10 seconds
backlog.recommendation: Undo for 10 seconds; cheaper than a confirm dialog with gloves.

backlog.title: Where do medicines, brands, methods and units come from?
backlog.detail: The list is a sample ('Antibiotic A', 'Sample brand A'). Farm configuration does not exist. Prescriptions is a separate feature that may supply the medicine.
options: Farm-configured list owned by management web
Fixed global list for the pilot
Prefill from Prescriptions when a task opened the form
backlog.recommendation: Farm-configured list, prefilled from Prescriptions when a task opened the form.

backlog.title: Which feed fields show, and on which page?
backlog.detail: ASTRA-FEED-PLAN-FIELDS proposes brand, supplier, energy, protein and lysine; none is drawn, and protein and lysine units are unconfirmed. Pen page, pig page or neither?
options: Pen page only: formula, brand, nutrition
Pig page only
Neither; keep formula, mode and kg
backlog.recommendation: Pen page: formula and brand only; nutrition values stay in the management web.

backlog.title: Does saving a feed change drop a body-condition link silently?
backlog.detail: Save ends the link between a Thin finding and its feed adjustment; Resolve warns but the editor does not. Body condition says 'Feed stays unchanged', so the link may be dead product.
options: Keep the link and warn on the editor
Drop linking entirely (body condition records only)
Link and end the finding too
backlog.recommendation: Drop linking entirely; delete the link copy on the finding and resolve screens.

backlog.title: One way back to the curve: mode, 0% or Reset?
backlog.detail: Follow curve, percent 0 and Reset all return to the curve. Three controls for one outcome add taps and confusion.
options: Keep Follow curve only
Keep Reset only
Keep all three
backlog.recommendation: Keep the Follow curve mode; remove Reset and treat 0% as the same state.

backlog.title: Should 'Hold amount' show kg and an end?
backlog.detail: The tag reads 'Feed held' with kg only in a tooltip; a gloved worker cannot see how much or until when. Hold also freezes the curve until reset.
options: Show 'Held 2.6 kg' on the tag
Keep tooltip; show on the pig page only
Remove Hold; use percent only
backlog.recommendation: Show 'Held 2.6 kg' on the tag, with no tooltip dependence.

backlog.title: Show a pen-wide feed change at the pen, not on every pig?
backlog.detail: A pen-wide +10% repeats as a tag on every row; the pen header shows only the new kg.
options: Tag once on the pen header; pig rows show only individual changes
Keep a tag per pig
Both
backlog.recommendation: Tag once on the pen header; show pig tags only for individual changes.

backlog.title: Hide or disable Adjust feed on ad-lib pens?
backlog.detail: Adjust feed is offered and always answers 'unavailable': a dead end on the main bottom button.
options: Hide the button
Show it disabled with the reason
Keep
backlog.recommendation: Hide the button; the page already says Ad-lib.

backlog.title: What do the 'Health' and 'Feed' counts count?
backlog.detail: Health counts any condition, ongoing included; Feed mixes pigs with a change and every pig in a pen whose formula is due. A worker reads both as 'pigs to check'.
options: Health = needs attention only; Feed = pigs with an individual change
Rename the lenses
Keep, add a one-line legend
backlog.recommendation: Count needs-attention pigs only; show formula-due at the pen header, not as pigs.

backlog.title: Should check-in require anything?
backlog.detail: Check-in is allowed with nothing recorded and pens unseen. Is a unit walk a fact the farm can rely on?
options: Allow always
Warn when pens are unvisited
Require every pen opened
backlog.recommendation: Warn with the unseen-pen count; do not block.

backlog.title: Show the care level as words on the row?
backlog.detail: Monitor, Treat in place and Move to hospital pen differ only by icon and colour; the words are in a tooltip. A gloved worker cannot tell them apart.
options: Words on every tag
Words on needs-attention tags only
Distinct icon shape
backlog.recommendation: Put the care word on needs-attention tags; ongoing keeps the neutral tag.

backlog.title: Edit and Close note overlap: keep one note per pen?
backlog.detail: Edit overwrites the author; Close archives to the log. Two actions on one note, and the first writer disappears from the card.
options: One note; edit keeps the original author line
Allow several notes
Keep
backlog.recommendation: Keep one note; show 'edited by' while keeping the first author.

backlog.title: One pig note that replaces the old one, or a list?
backlog.detail: A new note overwrites the previous one and the sheet does not say so; the log keeps both.
options: Keep one note; say it replaces
Short list of notes
Notes only in the log
backlog.recommendation: Notes only in the log; remove the overwrite.

backlog.title: What order and content for the pig record?
backlog.detail: Six blocks, with Batch, stage, Next task and Type repeated; a sow's age is in days; empty rows draw '—'. A worker at the pen needs care and next action first.
options: Attention, tasks, feeding, then a collapsed Details
Keep six blocks and hide empty rows
Tabs: Now, Facts, History
backlog.recommendation: Attention, tasks and feeding first; facts collapsed; hide empty rows; age in months for sows.

backlog.title: Draw lifetime figures or keep batch history only?
backlog.detail: Litters, born total, farrowing and weaning rates, interval and non-productive days are seeded but not drawn. Do supervisors need them on the phone?
options: Draw the main four on Production stats
Leave to the management web
Remove the seeded data
backlog.recommendation: Leave to the management web.

backlog.title: Can ear tag or breed be corrected from Origin?
backlog.detail: The page is read-only; a wrong ear tag or breed cannot be fixed. A mistaken tag is a common farm error.
options: Read-only on the phone
Edit for breed and tag with a log entry
Fix from the Pig list
backlog.recommendation: Read-only on the phone; corrections in the management web.

backlog.title: One door per finding: merge Edit, Resolve and Care instructions?
backlog.detail: Three bulk rows plus Edit finding and Resolve or remove change the same finding. Names clash: 'Resolve conditions' and 'Resolve or remove'.
options: One 'Update conditions' row with care and outcome together
Keep rows, rename them in line
Bulk only through selected pigs
backlog.recommendation: One row 'Update conditions' for one or many pigs, with care and outcome in one form.

backlog.title: Where do tasks live: card, Next task row, or Actions?
backlog.detail: The same task shows as a card on the record, as Next task and as a row in Actions with a cluster heading that repeats its name.
options: Cards on the record only; Actions opens the task
Actions only
Keep
backlog.recommendation: Cards on the record only; remove task rows from Actions.

backlog.title: Should Move pig overwrite her stage, and say so?
backlog.detail: Moving a pig sets her stage to the new batch's stage, which the form does not state.
options: Keep, and state it on the form
Do not change stage
Ask which
backlog.recommendation: Keep the rule and state it above the Save button.

backlog.title: Miscarriage reason: free text or evidence choices?
backlog.detail: Miscarriage takes free text while 'Not in pig' offers evidence choices; two forms for a similar loss, and no check for an outcome already recorded.
options: Same choices on both
Merge into one outcome form
Keep
backlog.recommendation: Merge into one 'Pregnancy ended' form with choices and optional text.

backlog.title: Drop the Health / General tabs in the action sheet?
backlog.detail: Two small groups sit in one scroll with footer tabs. Tabs add taps for a few rows.
options: Remove the tabs
Keep
Section headings only
backlog.recommendation: Remove the tabs.

backlog.title: Does Health own death and triage, or only conditions?
backlog.detail: Section text lists conditions, triage, deaths and treatments. Care replaced triage; deaths and prescriptions are separate features. Which belong in this section's contract?
options: Findings, care and treatment only
Include death and prescriptions
Rename the section
backlog.recommendation: Findings, care and treatment only; deaths and prescriptions get their own sections.

backlog.title: Catalogue is three levels deep with no recent list
backlog.detail: Tab, door, then item before a fever is chosen. A frequent condition sits two doors deep each time.

backlog.title: Two near-identical pickers: Choose conditions and Link condition
backlog.detail: Same catalogue with another layout for treatment. Gloved workers need one picker with a recent and common list on top.

backlog.title: Four rows for one finding; Edit and Resolve both change it
backlog.detail: Edit finding, Record treatment, Resolve or remove and Review feed adjustment compete. Needs one primary action and a clear secondary.

backlog.title: Care instructions and Edit conditions are one form under two titles
backlog.detail: Same screen, different log entry ('Triage updated' vs 'Finding edited'); the second title adds no function.

backlog.title: 'Health' means three things on one screen
backlog.detail: It labels every attention row, the Health field in details and the Actions group. Duration is 'Day 2' for attention and '120 days' for ongoing.

backlog.title: Temperature 39.5 is unflagged beside a Fever finding
backlog.detail: The reading sits in General details, far from the Fever row, and nothing marks it high. No sign whether treatment was given for Fever.

backlog.title: Care level differs only by icon and colour
backlog.detail: Four levels use small icons and colour; colour-blind workers and text-only readers cannot tell them apart.

backlog.title: Dose is 'per pig' in one place and 'for all' in another
backlog.detail: Dose labels differ between single and bulk; treatment from a finding and from the Health group differ only by a fixed condition.

backlog.title: Log wording differs: 'Record corrected' vs 'Finding entered in error'
backlog.detail: Bulk and single forms log the same outcome with two phrases. One wording per outcome.

backlog.title: Start date and author cannot be corrected on a finding
backlog.detail: Seeded findings show 'Recorded — · —'. The edit form changes name, care and note, never the start.

backlog.title: Two doors to a pen's feed; the note shows twice
backlog.detail: The pen header opens the editor, the Feed guidance row opens the reading page first. The note sits in a card, an Edit row and the pen log.

backlog.title: Filter state has batch, health status and manual feed, but no controls
backlog.detail: Three filters exist in state and the strip label but cannot be set. The Health lens and condition/care filters overlap.

backlog.title: Scan and Search open almost the same sheet; no ear-notch search
backlog.detail: The identity notes list ear-notch search, absent here. Camera scanning is a stub with a sample-tag button. Untagged groups cannot be found.

backlog.title: Three names for one thing: Log, Updates this walk, This walk
backlog.detail: Button, aria label and sheet title differ, and the same events repeat in each pig log and the pen log.

backlog.title: Two Back controls do the same thing
backlog.detail: The header Back and 'Back to unit' on the confirmation both return to the unit.

backlog.title: Log category is inferred from titles for old entries
backlog.detail: A renamed title silently falls into Notes. The same log and filter bar is shared with the pig log.

backlog.title: Long-press peek is hard with gloves; 'N health' misreads as pigs
backlog.detail: Hold 350 ms is hard with gloves and not discoverable. '2 health' counts ongoing conditions, not pigs needing care.

backlog.title: Selected sheet shows raw stage 'Gestating'
backlog.detail: The row repeats 'Gestating' where the list says 'Gestation · 40 days', and has no pen context for the pig.

backlog.title: Sheet header says only '2 pigs' and names nobody
backlog.detail: The worker cannot confirm who the action applies to. Body condition also sits under Measurements though it creates a health finding.

backlog.title: Row clock and record clock disagree
backlog.detail: Row: 'Gestation · 40 days' (days in stage); record: 'Last service · 40 days ago'. Two clocks that can differ; the screen duplicates the walk with one row changed.

backlog.title: Check-in sheet shows a large zero when nothing was recorded
backlog.detail: 'Recorded during this walk 0' dominates; the empty state could say so in words.

backlog.title: 'Formula due' on the walk has no explanation here
backlog.detail: Nothing tells the worker what formula change is due or when; the page shows only formula, mode and kg.

backlog.title: Editor carries mode, percent, slider, chips and a table for one decision
backlog.detail: Too much for gloved hands on one sheet; a pen-total preview exists in code and is not drawn. The scope reads '3 pigs' without naming the pen.

backlog.title: 'Feed for these pigs' sits under a tab called Pens
backlog.detail: Pens and pigs mean the same row. No row reaches equipment faults though a pen chooser exists in the code.

backlog.title: Pig feed page cannot adjust and repeats the record's block
backlog.detail: The only change path is the Actions sheet; the Feeding block is identical on the record. The curve source name is not drawn.

backlog.title: A decrease uses the same neutral tag as an increase
backlog.detail: Direction is only the sign; nothing distinguishes a drop in feed visually.

backlog.title: Four dashes in a row read as a broken page
backlog.detail: Service, farrowing, backfat and Health show '—' rows where the 'absent, not none' rule says to leave the row out.

backlog.title: Dash grid dominates; attention rows are the only content
backlog.detail: The worst case still draws Age, Breed, Weight, Temperature, Health as '—'. Hide empty rows.

backlog.title: Task type word shares names with Actions groups
backlog.detail: 'Health' and 'Production' mean task type here and action group there; tasks also appear in Actions.

backlog.title: An extra menu sits between Actions and each reading
backlog.detail: Three or four rows before the form: one more tap per reading, with body condition mixed in.

backlog.title: Body condition silently becomes a 'needs attention' Monitor finding
backlog.detail: The form does not say that the pig will show as needing attention on the walk.

backlog.title: Blocked actions sit one tap behind Actions
backlog.detail: The list usually holds one or two rows; the reason could sit on the disabled row itself.

backlog.title: Current batch shows two bare headings and little content
backlog.detail: 'Current batch' and 'This cycle' label a thin card; boars get 'Finish record' while sows get 'Finish weaning'.

backlog.title: 'Author not supplied' on seeded entries; name changes Log / Pig log
backlog.detail: The seed lacks authors, and the link and title use different names.

backlog.title: Section promises untagged groups and ear-notch search; no screen shows them
backlog.detail: Pigs says one row can mean several head and search takes an ear notch. The profile covers per-tag sows only; the Pig list entry has no source screen.

backlog.title: Walk shows no untagged groups, though the section says it does
backlog.detail: The sample unit has only tagged pigs and a single piglet (inspection.animal-types); a litter as a group is not drawn.

backlog.title: Who writes pen log entries and how long are they kept?
backlog.detail: Entries with no date stay under 'Before this walk'; custom range needs both dates. Authorship and retention are not stated.

backlog.title: What happens to a held pig as the curve grows?
backlog.detail: Hold fixes today's kg until reset; no rule says if growth or a move resets it. No expiry unless an end date is set.

backlog.title: Unticked pigs inside a ticked pen still change
backlog.detail: Opening from pens captures the pens' current pigs, unlike ticked-pig selection; the sheet only says '3 pens · 7 pigs'.

backlog.title: Adjust feed unavailable reason uses only the first pig
backlog.detail: If the first selected pig is dead and a later one is ad-lib, the reason covers one pig; no rule for mixed selections.

backlog.title: Latest treatment line shows only if it targeted this finding
backlog.detail: A treatment given for another condition is not shown here, though the pig record shows it.

backlog.title: 'Complete task / Follow up' says nothing about what was done
backlog.detail: Non-pregnancy production tasks have no outcomes; the notes do not say which tasks use this pair.

backlog.title: Pig list entry has no source screen
backlog.detail: The PRD lists the Pig list as an entry point, but that feature is a placeholder written elsewhere. How a pig is picked there is not shown.

backlog.title: Dead sow: which findings can still change?
backlog.detail: The mixed screen says conditions stay visible but cannot be changed; the notes do not say if a note or care change is allowed.

backlog.title: Placeholder screens name no owner or removal plan
backlog.detail: Thirteen placeholder screens render the plain walk, with no note saying who removes or draws them. A developer may build them from the notes.

backlog.title: Home uses the banned verb Complete for ending tasks
backlog.detail: 'Review & complete task' opens 'Ready to complete … Complete the task', whose button says End task; closed cards read 'Completed', the receipt 'Task complete'. strings.json bans Complete: tasks are ended. Fix: 'End task', 'Ready to end', 'Ended · Today'.

backlog.title: Waiting reason is one generic sentence that fits nothing
backlog.detail: Before first count, Edit record and the empty death drawer all say 'Complete the required fields first'; none has required fields, and 'Complete' is banned. Fix: say the one step that makes the button live ('Count the first piglet', 'Change a count to save', 'Add a death').

backlog.title: Prototype disclaimers are written into the product copy
backlog.detail: PREVIEW badges, 'Apply preview setting', 'Save sample issue', 'Issue resolved in this preview', 'Sample readings · …' sit inside the phone. As the spec, these become shipped strings. Fix: product verbs inside the phone; keep the demo disclaimer outside it.

backlog.title: Fan speed is a thin slider, hard with gloves
backlog.detail: A 0-100 range slider in steps of 5 needs a precise drag; it is not one of the DS fields. Fix: a Stepper (−/+ 5%, 48px keys) with the value in mono.

backlog.title: No Chinese rendering, so zh fit cannot be checked
backlog.detail: Farrowing, Home and Environment prototypes render English only; no lang switch exists, though strings.json holds zh. Long zh labels on lenses, tiles and hold captions are untested. Fix: a ?lang=zh switch on each prototype.

backlog.title: Receipt has two exits and an off-format stamp
backlog.detail: Footer holds 'Back' and 'Back to Today' (Home's tab is 'Home'); the stamp '10 Oct, 03:23 · G. Hansen' uses the device clock and a third date format beside 'Aug 27 at 08:12' and 'Thu, 8 Jul'.
options: One exit 'Back', ruled stamp 'Oct 10 · 03:23 · G.H'
One exit 'Home', same stamp
backlog.recommendation: One exit 'Back' and the ruled stamp; the receipt is a dead end either way.

backlog.title: Is End task red or ink?
backlog.detail: The README says 'End task' is red-filled; farrowing's all-finished End task and Home's Ready to complete draw it ink, while End task early is red. One verb, two colours.
options: Red for every task ending
Red only for End early; ink for a normal end (update README)
backlog.recommendation: Red only for End early: a normal end loses nothing; update the README line.

backlog.title: Today's date is amber with no meaning
backlog.detail: 'Thu, 8 Jul' beside Today's work is amber on every Home view; amber means due now or waiting to upload. Fix: muted.

backlog.title: Active is light green on the bar, blue on rows
backlog.detail: Whole-task progress draws Active as pale green, but the row chip uses the progress blue; green means done. 'Current unit' under Unit 7 is 9px, below the 10px floor. Fix: progress colour for Active; meta size for the note.

backlog.title: Home and Farrowing name the same states differently
backlog.detail: Home's card says '2 sows farrowing' and 'Farrowings recorded 7 / 18'; one tap later the task says '2 active' and '7 / 18 Farrowed'. Fix: Home uses the task's words (Active, Farrowed).

backlog.title: A lone Back is drawn as the ink primary
backlog.detail: Choose unit and the resolved issue drawer show a full-width ink 'Back' beside the head ✕. Ink fill is for the act; Back takes back-border. Fix: secondary Back, or the ✕ alone.

backlog.title: Toolbox and Scan carry study links and demo text
backlog.detail: Toolbox lists 'Shared component study ↗', 'Task card gallery ↗' and 'Records · Updates made in this preview'; Scan says 'Scanner preview… Use a sample tag'. Fix: move study links and disclaimers outside the phone.

backlog.title: Equipment faults reported from two doors under two names
backlog.detail: The farrowing pen sheet offers 'Report equipment fault'; Environment offers 'Report issue' / 'Report equipment issue' for the same record. Fix: one noun ('issue') and one drawer, reached from both.

backlog.title: Environment strip units are 9px, below the floor
backlog.detail: On the unit hub '°C', '%' and 'ppm NH₃' render at 9px; meta at 10px is the floor and units must always be readable. Fix: 10px or larger.

backlog.title: Temperature named twice above one value
backlog.detail: The selected tab says Temperature and the card repeats 'Temperature' over 22.4 °C. Fix: drop the card label; the tab names it.

backlog.title: Hold caption differs from Farrowing's for the same act
backlog.detail: Home's End task early button is captioned 'HOLD TO END'; Farrowing's is 'HOLD TO END EARLY'. Fix: one caption per verb from strings.json.

backlog.title: Every drawer has both a header X and a footer Back
backlog.detail: Pen sheet, fewer piglets, death, boars and gilts, weight, set count and More actions each show X and Back that do the same thing. Two controls, one act; the verbs give Back and Close different meanings. Fix: keep the footer Back only.

backlog.title: Move asks about treatments the pen record already answers
backlog.detail: Moving from A03, where Dock tail is done for all 12, still asks "Had tail docking? No / Yes". Fix: ask only about treatments partly given in the source pen; fill the rest from the record.

backlog.title: "Tagged 1 of 12" on a breeders-only farm implies 11 owed
backlog.detail: On a farm that tags breeders only, the Piglets card still reads Tagged 1 of 12 next to Breeders kept 1. The fraction suggests 11 untagged piglets. Fix: under the breeders scheme drop the Tagged fact; Breeders kept says it.

backlog.title: Tag piglets is both a tool button and a day item
backlog.detail: A03's sheet offers Tag piglets in the tool row and as the Day 3 item ("Not filled · 0 of 12 tagged"); both open the same list. Fix: show the tool only once the ID item is done or absent.

backlog.title: End task states "9 not done" three times
backlog.detail: Summary says "3 of 12 pens done" and "9 pens not done"; the group header repeats "Not done · 9 pens". Fix: keep "3 of 12 pens done" and the group title; drop the other two counts.

backlog.title: Three phrasings for one pen-allocated feed state
backlog.detail: Pen feeding row: "Follow curve"; pig Feed plan: "Included in pen allocation"; walk tag: "Included in daily feed". One state, three words. Fix: one string used on all three screens.

backlog.title: "Unchanged" filled badge on every row before any change
backlog.detail: Each pig row shows Current → New with identical values and a filled "Unchanged" badge; the law says status words are coloured text with a dot, never filled badges. Fix: show New and its status only once a change exists.

backlog.title: "Ad-lib" said twice in one card
backlog.detail: The Grower 1 card shows Ad-lib as the meta on the right and again as the Daily feed value. Fix: drop the meta; the value says it.

backlog.title: Dates appear in three formats across one pen
backlog.detail: Pen log groups by weekday (Thu, Wed, Sun), day cards say "Planned 10/08", the list says "10/09" or a bare time. The worker cannot match a log line to a day card. Fix: one format, weekday plus date.

backlog.title: Pen header and pen row are two doors to one sheet
backlog.detail: Each pen is a group whose header ("A02 · 1 sow ›") and only row both open the same sheet: two targets, two chevrons per pen. Fix: one row per pen, carrying the pen code.

backlog.title: Hint asks for a number that is already filled
backlog.detail: The tag is prefilled (001217) yet the disabled reason reads "Add the number and the sex". Only sex is missing. Fix: the hint names only what is missing ("Pick boar or gilt").

backlog.title: "Use 12" is not a registered verb
backlog.detail: The fewer-piglets sheet's primary reads "Use N"; strings.json has no Use, and nothing is recorded until the pen's Record. Which word?
options: Register "Use" as stage-a-count
"Tick 12" (Tick: choose subjects, nothing recorded until Record)
"Back" carrying the count, no primary
backlog.recommendation: "Tick 12": an existing verb with exactly this meaning.

backlog.title: Fever is not in the condition catalogue
backlog.detail: Searching 'fever' finds only swine fever diseases; recording a fever needs Add, then a category (five taps). Seeded 'Poor appetite' is 'Reduced appetite' in the catalogue, so seeded findings match no catalogue item.
options: Add Fever as a symptom under General appearance and rename seeds to catalogue names
Keep the catalogue; change the seeds to existing items
Treat fever as a temperature reading, not a symptom
backlog.recommendation: Add Fever under General appearance and make seed names match the catalogue.

backlog.title: Current tasks scroll sideways; the second task is hidden
backlog.detail: With 2 tasks (000254, 000306) the second card is a sliver past the right edge; only '2 tasks' hints it exists, so a gloved worker misses it. Fix: stack task rows vertically; they are few.

backlog.title: Next task says Pregnancy check while Vaccination is due today
backlog.detail: On 000306 Sow cycle's Next task reads 'Pregnancy check · in 1 day' while Current tasks leads with Vaccination due today. 'Next' counts only production tasks, so it contradicts the card above. Fix: drop Next task (Current tasks already shows it) or say what it counts.

backlog.title: Pickers hand-build their footer: wrong Back, 12px bottom, 'Done · 0'
backlog.detail: Select conditions and Select medicine use two equal 168px buttons, Back without chevron, 12px bottom padding (law: 86px Back, 28px bottom) and 'Done · 0' (counts only from 2). Fix: use the Sheet footer; Done shows a count from 2.

backlog.title: No Chinese: inspection, pig and health copy is hard-coded English
backlog.detail: The inspection prototype (also pig-profile and health-record) has no zh strings or language switch, so Chinese fit cannot be checked and verbs bypass ux/laws/strings.json. Piglet processing already does this. Fix: route copy through the strings registry with zh.

backlog.title: Form fields boxed in a tinted card, with the Note box inside
backlog.detail: Record health, Care instructions, Resolve conditions, Treatment and the measure, body and note forms wrap fields in a bordered inset card, with the Note row a second tinted box inside it. Edit finding and Pen note have no wrapper. Fix: drop the wrapper; fields sit on the drawer.

backlog.title: Weight entry is a native number box, not the Numpad
backlog.detail: Record weight, temperature and backfat use a browser number input with tiny spinner arrows and the phone keyboard, while the Numpad component exists for weights. Fix: use the compact Numpad with the unit on the field.

backlog.title: Is 'Save' an allowed verb? README bans it, strings.json defines it
backlog.detail: The DS README says never 'Save' or 'Complete'; strings.json defines Save. Forms say Save, Save note, Save changes, Save outcome and 'Save and complete' (Complete is banned).
options: Save is allowed for staged drafts (strings.json wins); drop 'and complete'
Name the act on every button (Record weight, Record outcome, Update note)
backlog.recommendation: Name the act (Record outcome, Record weight); keep Save only for edits of a posted record.

backlog.title: Measurements row text truncates; two rows use a chevron as icon
backlog.detail: 'Body condition, weight, temperature and back…' ends in an ellipsis, and Measurements & condition and Record backfat show a bare › as their icon tile. Fix: shorter description ('Weight, backfat, temperature, body') and real glyphs.

backlog.title: 20 of 24 pen tiles say 'Not in unit'
backlog.detail: The pen map repeats 'Not in unit' on every greyed tile, burying the four live pens; the caption 'Pen layout · only pens…' is hidden under the footer. Fix: leave non-unit tiles blank and pad the caption above the footer.

backlog.title: Pig record title sets the ear tag in sans, not mono
backlog.detail: The record heading '000267' renders in Plus Jakarta Sans; the walk and selected sheet set the same tag in IBM Plex Mono. Law: IDs are set in mono. Fix: identifier type on the title.

backlog.title: Task type shown as filled badges
backlog.detail: Task cards carry filled 'Health' (amber wash) and 'Production' (grey) pills. Law: status words are coloured text with a dot, never filled badges; amber means due now. Fix: drop the pill; the icon tile already marks type.

backlog.title: Picker hides the pig: walk shows behind, no subject line
backlog.detail: Opened from 000267's Record health, Select conditions shows the Inspection walk behind it and has no subtitle, so the worker loses which pig they are recording. Fix: keep the form behind and add '000267 · C1' under the title.

backlog.title: Blocked actions keep chevrons and read as doors
backlog.detail: Resolve conditions and Care instructions show a › and row press though they open nothing. Fix: drop the chevron; keep the reason line.

backlog.title: Pen note stamp uses full name, not initials
backlog.detail: The note card reads 'G. Hansen · today · 06:40'. Law: people are initials on records (G.H), full name only on a check-in stamp; the pen log shows the same note as G.H. Fix: '06:40 · G.H'.

backlog.title: Figures at two scopes look like one measure
backlog.detail: Unit card and tabs count Unit 7; the task card counts all units, and only it names its scope. Active and Awaiting print three times (bar, support line, tabs). "Done 2" and "Farrowed 7" look alike but count differently.

backlog.title: Do pen headers keep feed, fault, note and log tools?
backlog.detail: Pen headers open pen tools, though rulings call pen headers census-only. Unclear whose feature these tools are; the farrowing PRD lists them as out of scope.
options: Keep them in farrowing
Move them to a shared pen feature
Remove from the room list; pen header opens nothing
backlog.recommendation: Remove from the room list now and give them a shared pen feature later; fewer doors on a gloved screen.

backlog.title: Should the due-range filter touch Active and Done sows?
backlog.detail: The due range matches each sow's stored due text, so it also hides Active and Done sows by a date that no longer matters to them. Tab counts shrink with it.
options: Filter applies to Awaiting sows only
Filter applies to all sows (as built)
Replace due range with one Overdue chip
backlog.recommendation: Apply the due and parity filter to Awaiting only; Active and Done sows always show.

backlog.title: Filter sheet, Range slider, Choice chips are undrawn placeholders
backlog.detail: Only farrowing.room uses these three placeholder parts. No spec, states or gate; a two-handle date slider is hard for gloved thumbs. Piglet processing filters with TaskChips instead.

backlog.title: Home farrowing card opens Task overview over the room
backlog.detail: Owner call: Home's whole-farm card lands on the room list. The prototype shows the Task overview sheet first, then Back returns to Home, so the room is never the first thing seen.

backlog.title: Row recency, hand and "Last record" have no computing rule
backlog.detail: "1h ago", "G.H" and "Last record 08:41" are fixed sample text. No rule for wording thresholds (just now, minutes, hours, yesterday, date), whose hand shows after several edits, or what Overdue rows show as line 2.

backlog.title: Last record line repeats each row's recency
backlog.detail: The header line duplicates the newest row's "1h ago · G.H"; the ruled one-sentence task copy under it is missing. Information budget: pick one place for recency.

backlog.title: Two search doors: magnifier and Scan ear tag text box
backlog.detail: Search opens "Find a sow" and Scan ear tag also holds a text search. Two doors to one result list; the scan sheet has no camera in the prototype.

backlog.title: Unit card never shows its neutral Target state
backlog.detail: The prototype hard-codes the amber below-target flag, so the neutral state (figure meets target) is never drawn or testable.

backlog.title: Unsaved Edit draft: invisible on row, home unspecified
backlog.detail: An Edit draft kept with Back blocks Finish and End task, but the sow's row shows nothing. No rule says where the draft lives, whether another phone sees it, or when it expires.

backlog.title: Four exits for one sheet: X, Back, handle, backdrop
backlog.detail: Rulings keep handle, backdrop and one bar exit but no close button. The sheet draws X and Back that do the same thing; the exit word rule is Back.

backlog.title: Born and Dead repeat on Counting, Finish, locked record and log
backlog.detail: The same Born / Dead (and Alive) figures are redrawn on four surfaces one tap apart. Rank which one the worker must see on each; the hero should own the total.

backlog.title: Header lacks ruled recency stamp and day count
backlog.detail: Header status word "Farrowing" repeats the room chip, and the ruled recency stamp and gestation day are missing. Also true of Before first count, which prints the Due text the row just showed.

backlog.title: Pointer text replaces the receipt and shifts the layout
backlog.detail: The greyed-minus pointer differs from the ruled two-pointer copy and takes the receipt's place for 4 s, so the hero area changes height under a tapping thumb.

backlog.title: "Record dead" or "Record death" for the button name?
backlog.detail: RULINGS says Record dead; farrowing count, locked and drawer title read Record death, and piglet processing also says Record death. One verb for the one shared drawer.
options: Record dead (ruling)
Record death (prototype, both tasks)
backlog.recommendation: Record dead, as ruled; change the prototypes.

backlog.title: Disabled minus is aria-only; behaviour at the floor not specified
backlog.detail: At the floor the minus is only aria-disabled; whether it looks disabled depends on CSS, it stays focusable and a tap shows the pointer. State the intended disabled contract.

backlog.title: Edit and Finish drawn dimmed with no reason shown
backlog.detail: Edit and Finish farrowing are greyed on Before first count, and Finish stays greyed with no reason. Rulings allow dimming only for the Alive minus floor; waiting buttons need a visible reason (see gate on Button).

backlog.title: Receipt copy contradicts ruling that removed the instruction
backlog.detail: "Tap + as piglets are born" is the instruction the ruling removed; it belongs under the room title, where it is also missing. Decide where the first-use hint lives.

backlog.title: Does leaving the dead drawer keep or discard the draft?
backlog.detail: Rulings: Back keeps the draft, Clear discards. Prototype: Back, X, swipe and backdrop all discard it, so "N unsaved", Finish's "Save piglet deaths first" and the death-draft blocked state never appear.
options: Keep the draft (ruling), show "N unsaved" on the sheet and row
Discard on leave; Save is the only commit (prototype)
Discard on leave with a confirm when the draft is non-empty
backlog.recommendation: Discard with a confirm when non-empty: removes the unreachable blocked variants and fits the simplicity rule. Reverses a ruling, so the owner must nod.

backlog.title: Dead drawer shows no sow id or pen
backlog.detail: Header reads "Dead 6 · Born dead or died"; the worker cannot see which sow is being recorded, and the drawer opens from five places.

backlog.title: Draft told three ways: header, "1 unsaved", green row
backlog.detail: "Dead 6", "1 unsaved" and the green value all say the same draft. Photo field is a header row with an icon button, not the ruled single card, and sits under the fold.

backlog.title: After the lock, where are piglet deaths recorded?
backlog.detail: Locked and ended farrowing records offer Record death, and the processing pen sheet has its own Record death. Two doors for one fact; Q9 wants one shared dead picker. No rule says which task owns post-lock deaths.
options: Farrowing locked record only
Processing pen sheet only; farrowing locked bar drops it
Both, writing one ledger via the same drawer
backlog.recommendation: Both doors open the one shared dead drawer and write the same record; no duplicate entry forms.

backlog.title: May piglet deaths be recorded after the sow has died?
backlog.detail: Ended records allow piglet deaths; the ruling is silent. The sow's alive piglets move to piglet care, where processing records deaths too.
options: Allow, as built
Block; route to processing
backlog.recommendation: Allow: same door as a locked record, so rules stay uniform.

backlog.title: Steppers still 44px, below the 48px glove floor
backlog.detail: TaskStepper row face and farrowing .row-stepper keys are 44x44, and farrowing hand-rolls three look-alike steppers instead of SentriTask.stepper. Sow count keys are the most-tapped control.

backlog.title: Primary button repeats the sheet title
backlog.detail: The ruled button is "Lock born N"; the prototype reads "Finish farrowing", the same words as the sheet title. The Born / Alive / Dead panel repeats Counting one tap earlier.

backlog.title: Litter weight and Assistance are two buttons, not one group
backlog.detail: Rulings ask for one cohesive optional group. Two collapsed buttons are drawn, and the ruled soft warning for litter weight outside 0.8-2.5 kg per alive piglet does not exist.

backlog.title: Death-draft variant of Lock blocked cannot be reached
backlog.detail: Only the Edit-draft route reaches it, because leaving the death drawer clears the draft. Banner copy and layout also differ from the ruled "1 death unsaved · Record dead" pointer above the bar.

backlog.title: Locked record is a facts list, not the ruled record face
backlog.detail: Ruling: one summary card (14 born | 8 alive | 6 dead), rows At finish / Finished / Farrowing record, bar Edit · Record dead. Built: seven-row list, Edit and Record death in an action row, View log as a title link. Dead is told three ways.

backlog.title: A missing piglet after the lock has no door
backlog.detail: Edge case says it "routes through the litter census elsewhere". No spec says where, and Set count (processing) is the only count tool; developers cannot tell which screen owns it.

backlog.title: Edit Save dimmed and Clear in header, against ruling
backlog.detail: Ruling: Save absent before a change, never greyed; Clear on the change-summary row. Built: Save dimmed from entry, Clear in the header.

backlog.title: Edit lets Alive drop below the floor; Born effect unexplained
backlog.detail: Alive can go below the counting floor, which changes derived Born, and nothing on screen explains it. Needs a rule on how a pre-lock Alive correction restates Born in the log.

backlog.title: Died option shows the full cause list inline in the popup
backlog.detail: More born > Died opens six causes inside a popup, long on a small phone. The Edit screen behind the popup is not shown on its own anywhere.

backlog.title: Selected radio shows a blue browser focus ring
backlog.detail: The first radio in the Correct born popup draws a default blue box, off-palette against the 2px ink ring ruled for radios.

backlog.title: Finish details opens a page; ruling expands the row in place
backlog.detail: Prototype pushes a separate "Edit finish details" page, the ruling expands the row. PRD also calls it "At finish", the screen "Finish details".

backlog.title: Log lacks ruled rail, amber corrections and red sow-death mark
backlog.detail: Title is "Farrowing log"; the copy pass names it "Farrowing record". No amber correction values or red sow-death milestone as ruled. Gate agrees: one act, one entry, detail never repeats the title.

backlog.title: Sow-died record misses ruled "Farrowing record" row
backlog.detail: The stamp inside the band and the Farrowing record row are missing; the death is told in the stamp, the band and the room chip, and the face is the generic summary.

backlog.title: Can the task end while sows are still farrowing?
backlog.detail: Prototype blocks ending on active sows and unsaved drafts (ruling Q5). State contract C9 says closing is never blocked; Round 4 says End is allowed with review items open. Three sources disagree.
options: Block on active sows and drafts (as built)
Block on active sows only; drafts dropped with a warning
Never block; list as unresolved at End
backlog.recommendation: Block on active sows only. Unsaved drafts are listed and dropped with a clear warning, so one stuck draft cannot hold the batch.

backlog.title: Same counts shown by warnings, outcomes, overview and receipt
backlog.detail: Warning cards, Task outcomes rows, the overview card, Performance metrics and the receipt state the same counts three to four times across the end flow.

backlog.title: Outcome rows total 19 sows; progress bar says 18
backlog.detail: End review header and outcomes list 19 sows (e.g. Finished 18 + Sow deaths 1), but the overview denominator is 18. A sow that died after finishing is counted in Farrowed and again in Sow deaths.

backlog.title: Where do awaiting sows go when the task ends early?
backlog.detail: Ending early marks awaiting sows "removed from this batch", a marker only; no transfer is built and the card does not say where they go. Pig-profile says removal returns a sow to rebreed watch.
options: Marker only, nothing else changes
Return to rebreed watch (as batch removal does)
Carry into the next batch's awaiting list
backlog.recommendation: Return to rebreed watch and say so on the warning card.

backlog.title: Removal card and "Awaiting 9" row state the same fact
backlog.detail: The amber removal warning and the Awaiting farrowing outcome row both say 9; one should go.

backlog.title: With no warnings, End is two summaries already on the overview
backlog.detail: The all-finished review adds no information beyond the Task overview; consider ending from the overview directly.

backlog.title: Miscarriage and "Not in pig" entry forms are not designed
backlog.detail: Outcomes appear in counts, but the Record miscarriage, Mark not in pig and Edit litter record rows on the pig Actions sheet (in PRD scope) have no screen; atlas shows pig-profile addsTo as not added.

backlog.title: Unit chooser duplicates Home's Choose unit
backlog.detail: Both list units with their progress; the overview also repeats progress, performance and outcomes that End and the receipt show.

backlog.title: Frozen receipt vs live sow records after End
backlog.detail: Receipt figures come from the closure event, but "sow records stay live". No rule says whether a later correction changes, annotates or is excluded from the receipt, or who is told.

backlog.title: Third appearance of performance and outcome blocks
backlog.detail: Overview, End review and receipt show the same two cards. The receipt should carry only who, when and what changed since.

backlog.title: Prototype-only values: draft, recency, hand not computed
backlog.detail: Several notes mark values as fixed sample text. Developers need the data source for recency, hand, Last record, due text, and the draft store before the freeze.

backlog.title: "3 / 12 pens done" counts pens not started as done
backlog.detail: Pens with every step ahead (B05, B06) count done, so 1 finished pen shows as 3. PRD says Done means nothing left and nothing ahead. The same rule feeds the Done chip and End page.

backlog.title: What should "pens done" and the Done chip count?
backlog.detail: Owner open item: a pen with nothing due yet counts as done. It overstates progress, lists unstarted pens under Done, and End shows them again under "Not due yet".
options: Done = nothing left and nothing ahead (PRD); bar never reaches 100% before End
Count only pens that owe something today; Coming pens leave both sides
Keep as built
backlog.recommendation: Coming pens leave numerator and denominator: "3 of 9 pens done today".

backlog.title: Is bulk recording by job chip built, as Rounds 8-9 ruled?
backlog.detail: Round 9: tap a job chip, tick through pens, one "Finish iron treatment" hold; Round 8 adds a window override. Prototype chips only filter, so every pen opens separately. Owner twice kept bulk.
options: Build as ruled
Filter only for v1; bulk after the freeze
Drop bulk
backlog.recommendation: Build the smallest form: chip, tick pens inside the window, one hold. Outside-window pens stay a manual override.

backlog.title: No way back to Home from the pen list
backlog.detail: Header has no back control, unlike farrowing's room; the only exit is the browser. Latest commit says Back on every bar.

backlog.title: Pen list has no dock, search, scan or Go to pen
backlog.detail: The skeleton ends in a dock; farrowing has Go to pen, Scan ear tag and Search. Processing shows 12 pens with none of them, though a batch can hold dozens and tags are the identifier.

backlog.title: Summary card names one job; chips show bigger ones
backlog.detail: The card says "Iron 6" while Tag is 7; only the first job in plan order is named, so the headline is not the biggest or most urgent workload.

backlog.title: Pen code and sow id repeat; header says "1 sow" everywhere
backlog.detail: Group header and row both name the pen and sow, and "1 sow" is printed on every pen because multi-sow pens are out of scope. Pure noise on a 12-row list.

backlog.title: Home and the task disagree on batch, pens and timing
backlog.detail: Home says Batch 27, 8 pens, care due tomorrow; the list shows Batch 40, 12 pens, 6 due today.

backlog.title: "Last record 08:20" has no date
backlog.detail: Time only, never the date, so it can be yesterday's; the newest row shows 10/09. The Tag chip's tip string (sp.chip.id.tip) is also never shown.

backlog.title: Tag and Done chips sit off-screen in the scroll row
backlog.detail: At 390px the row ends at "Castrate 6" with a fade; Tag 7 and Done 3, the two most-used filters, need a sideways swipe to discover.

backlog.title: Job chip shows pens but nothing to tick
backlog.detail: The list is only a filter; every pen still opens to record. See the bulk decision on the pen list.

backlog.title: Done chip lists pens that have not started
backlog.detail: B05 and B06 ("Iron tomorrow") appear next to finished A01 under Done.

backlog.title: How is a farm's ID scheme set in the product?
backlog.detail: The scheme (tag, notch, breeders only, none) is a Demo switch outside the phone. Round 2 Q17 also wants who, which day and the done rule configured.
options: Farm-level console setting, read-only in the app
Per batch, chosen when the task starts
Per task, editable by the supervisor
backlog.recommendation: Farm-level console setting; the app only reads it.

backlog.title: ID step window (day 3-7) is a builder guess
backlog.detail: PRD lists "ID window day 3-7" as interpreted by the builder; Q17 says the age-day is farm config. The step turns late after day 7, with no cut-off ruling.

backlog.title: First-in wins, second kept as a note: confirm or revert?
backlog.detail: PRD: "simplification, not yet confirmed". Rulings Q8 and Round 4/6 keep both records and flag "Given twice" or "Different piglets"; those answers are dropped here.
options: First wins; second kept as a note, never counted
Keep both, flag a possible double dose (rulings)
First wins and ask the second worker "same piglets?"
backlog.recommendation: First wins, second kept as a note: nothing for farmers to answer.

backlog.title: Clash note has no dismiss rule or placement spec
backlog.detail: An amber note sits above the summary until OK; whether it queues when several arrive, and how it behaves offline, is not stated.

backlog.title: Not-yet-due sheet gives no opening day
backlog.detail: Everything is greyed "Not due yet · can be done early" yet nothing says which day opens first except the list headline.

backlog.title: Which event starts pen day 1, and where do dates come from?
backlog.detail: Day cards print "Planned 10/07" derived from pen age, not a farrowing date. Farrowing has no "when"; a litter can take hours or days. Needs a rule: day 1 is the finish date, the first count, or the sow's date.

backlog.title: Castration is owed for boars only; prototype owes all piglets
backlog.detail: Castrate ticks all live piglets, and fewer piglets forces "Why fewer? Weak / Sick", so gilts would have to be recorded as weak. Q16 recorded castrated vs not, split by reason.
options: Owe boars only, using Boars · gilts or the IDs' sex
Owe all piglets; add a reason "gilts" and others
Show Castrate only after sex is known
backlog.recommendation: Owe boars only; use the saved Boars · gilts split, and show Castrate for all when unknown.

backlog.title: Piglets card: four facts, four doors, plus a weigh nag
backlog.detail: Boars/gilts, Litter weight, Tagged and Breeders kept each open a different sheet, with a weigh hint above the tool row. Q18 says processing records weight "only when missing, no nag".

backlog.title: Losses "come off untreated piglets first" is a builder rule
backlog.detail: A death or Set count lowers alive and caps treatments given at alive, assuming the lost piglets were untreated first. Not ruled; a treated piglet dying leaves "given" wrong for the pen.

backlog.title: Treatment windows: constants or console config, one dose only?
backlog.detail: Windows (Iron 2-4, Tail 2-4, Castrate 3-7, Cocci 3-5, ID 3-7) are fixed. Q2 sends product and dose from console; Q12 makes each dose its own obligation (iron d3, d14). Source and multi-dose support not stated.

backlog.title: May the breeders pick close with no breeders?
backlog.detail: Builder rule: "Done picking · no breeders" closes the step. Q17 lets the worker close the set; no ruling says zero keepers is valid.
options: Allowed (as built)
Require at least one breeder
Ask "no breeders?" once
backlog.recommendation: Allowed with one confirm.

backlog.title: Keep one "late" state or add Round 2's "missed"?
backlog.detail: Q15 had a lapsed state: missed past the last age-day, counting as owed at End (Round 7). Prototype: everything past its window is late forever, per Q6 "no clinical cut-off".
options: Late only (as built); End lists as not given
Add missed after the last window day
backlog.recommendation: Late only: farmers get one word; End already lists what was not given.

backlog.title: How is a wrong record corrected, before and after End?
backlog.detail: Q7 and Round 1: Edit by anyone, stamped, original kept, writable after End. Prototype: only Undo within the visit; Edit and all after-End writes were cut (HANDOFF open 1). A wrong done row stays wrong.
options: Edit as ruled (stamped, original kept)
Withdraw a done row (stamped, kept), then re-record; read-only after End
Undo within the visit only (as built)
backlog.recommendation: Withdraw and re-record, like crossing out on paper; no value edit; read-only after End.

backlog.title: Done pen still offers Submit and Tag piglets
backlog.detail: A fully done pen shows a disabled Submit and a Tag piglets tool when 12 of 12 are tagged. The Done card's "Show" label also reads as a title.

backlog.title: Only Weak and Sick as reasons: add Other or exempt reasons?
backlog.detail: Round 2 reasons (hernia, cryptorchid, kept boar) were cut. Fewer piglets with no fitting reason forces a false one, especially for castrate.
options: Weak, Sick only
Add Other (no text)
Per-treatment reasons
backlog.recommendation: Add Other with no text; revisit per-treatment after the castration decision.

backlog.title: "Tagged x of y" appears three times
backlog.detail: Group header, Piglets card and the ID item meta all say it. Also unclear: dead piglets keep their tags on this list because deaths are counted, not picked.

backlog.title: Give IDs never stops after the last piglet
backlog.detail: After the last piglet the form offers another; the count left ("8 without ID") lives only in the description. Add a done state.

backlog.title: Sex required per piglet, but Q3 says never block
backlog.detail: Record stays disabled until a sex is tapped. Q3: sex and weight are optional and never block. Sex feeds boars/gilts and castration but adds a tap to every piglet.
options: Required (as built); amend Q3
Optional; fill from Boars · gilts later
backlog.recommendation: Required: castration and breeders both need it.

backlog.title: Where does per-piglet work live: tasks or a universal feature?
backlog.detail: Round 10 direction: ID, weigh, sex and breeder pick may become universal. Proposal pending; ranking is placeholder. Impacts this whole sheet set.
options: Universal feature opened from any task
Keep inside piglet processing for v1
backlog.recommendation: Keep inside processing for v1; build as shared parts so it can move.

backlog.title: Boars plus gilts not checked against alive
backlog.detail: The two steppers can total more or fewer than the pen's alive count with no warning; castration depends on this number.

backlog.title: Litter weight here vs birth litter weight in farrowing
backlog.detail: Both are labelled "Litter weight" (12.6 kg at birth; 24.6 kg on day 6). No rule on how they differ, which wins, or whether processing may overwrite the farrowing figure.

backlog.title: Second weighing appended; no plausibility check
backlog.detail: Glossary says replace on the same day and refuse over 6 kg per piglet; built appends and accepts anything. Weight log lines also show no who or when.

backlog.title: More actions has no notes; Edit tool is missing
backlog.detail: The sheet lists Move piglets and Set count with no elements or states. Round 5 lists Edit among the pen tools; it was cut.

backlog.title: Is count-by-cause enough, or build the shared dead picker?
backlog.detail: Q9 (owner, in principle): processing uses the one shared dead picker, listing tagged piglets. Built: a count-by-cause sheet with four causes (farrowing has six). Tags stay listed after a death.
options: Shared dead drawer (same component), untagged by cause
Shared drawer that also picks tagged piglets
Count-by-cause sheet (as built)
backlog.recommendation: Use the farrowing dead drawer component by cause; picking tagged piglets is later.

backlog.title: Moved piglets' IDs do not move to the new pen
backlog.detail: Piglets tagged before the move keep tags, but the IDs stay on the old pen, so Tagged x of y and the Piglets list disagree on both pens.

backlog.title: Do moved piglets follow the source or destination schedule?
backlog.detail: A day-4 piglet moved to a day-1 pen is marked "moved in" and owed under the receiving pen's age. Q14 says they carry what the source owed; the receiving-pen suggestion was cut.
options: Destination pen age (as built)
Source pen age, shown on the piglet
Block moves across more than 2 days
backlog.recommendation: Destination pen age; warn when the gap is more than 2 days.

backlog.title: Pen tiles do not scale; Move vs lock rule unchecked
backlog.detail: Tiles list every pen with only a day; a real batch holds dozens. Q13 allows Move only after farrowing lock, and no check is shown.

backlog.title: What does "N piglets unaccounted" do for the worker?
backlog.detail: Set count writes a batch total that shows on the list and End but never says which pen, who or how it clears. Round 9 keeps it as a checker only.
options: Informational only (as built)
Tap shows pens with lower counts
Supervisor must acknowledge at End
backlog.recommendation: Tap opens the pens whose counts came in lower; still non-blocking.

backlog.title: Born is farrowing's number, not seen here
backlog.detail: Day 0 shows "Born 13"; the log cannot correct it and no link goes to the farrowing record.

backlog.title: Block End while the batch's farrowing is open?
backlog.detail: Q5 (agreed): cannot end while farrowing is open, with the reason shown. Not built: End is always available. Farrowing also has its own blocking question.
options: Block with a reason line (ruling)
Allow, list as unresolved
Block only for pens whose farrowing is open
backlog.recommendation: Block with the reason ("Farrowing still open · 2 sows").

backlog.title: Who may end the task?
backlog.detail: Code comment says the supervisor; no role check. Farrowing says provenance replaces permissions, and the PRD says "a supervisor ends the task".
options: Anyone, stamped (like farrowing)
Supervisors only
backlog.recommendation: Anyone, stamped; the hold is the guard.

backlog.title: End review is 12 pen rows, not "numbers"
backlog.detail: Q5 wants the review in numbers; the page lists each pen with steps and meta. "Not due yet" duplicates unstarted pens already counted done.

backlog.title: After End every row reads "Task ended"; done equals not done
backlog.detail: Chips go, the headline becomes "Task ended" for finished and unfinished pens alike, and the summary repeats "Not done 9" and "3 / 12 done". Done pens lose their chip.

backlog.title: After-End records: blocked, flagged-uncounted, or writable?
backlog.detail: Round 3: an after-End record is kept, stamped "after End", never counted. Round 1 Q7: corrections stay writable. Prototype blocks all writes, including other-phone sync.
options: Block all (as built)
Keep stamped "after End", not counted (Round 3)
backlog.recommendation: Block in the app; accept late sync as a flagged, uncounted record.

backlog.title: Atlas copy lists show string keys, not copy
backlog.detail: Every piglet screen's copy field holds raw keys ("sp.task", "sp.sum.due") instead of text, so a developer or translator cannot read the screens' copy.

backlog.title: Which build is the one to freeze: simple/ or the full task?
backlog.detail: HANDOFF open 4: carry simplified flows into the full task or promote simple/ as the task. The full-task rulings (Edit, Explain, bulk hold, shared dead picker) are not built in simple/.
options: Promote simple/ as the task
Carry simple/ flows into the full task
backlog.recommendation: Promote simple/; add only bulk and the shared dead picker.

backlog.title: Confirm builder rules: Move asks "Have tags?"; Tag chip filters
backlog.detail: Unconfirmed builder interpretations: Move asks "Have tags?", the Tag chip only filters (no bulk tagging), a higher count just corrects, past-window sheet records auto-late.
options: Confirm all
Reject the Tag-chip filter-only rule
backlog.recommendation: Confirm all; revisit with the bulk decision.

backlog.title: Approve the 24 candidate Task parts, tokens and colour snaps?
backlog.detail: All Task* parts are "candidate, not approved", with no gate.json. ADR 0003 lists candidate tokens, colour snaps and a full-bleed status bar as still open for the owner at close.
options: Approve as a set
Approve only parts both tasks use
Hold until gated
backlog.recommendation: Gate every part first (none has run), then approve as a set.

backlog.title: Chips or lens tabs as every task's list filter?
backlog.detail: Processing filters by job with chips; farrowing by status with lens tabs. ADR: "decided per task for now". Other tasks have no design yet.
options: Two named variants: tabs for status, chips for jobs
Chips everywhere
Tabs everywhere
backlog.recommendation: Two named variants; document each in the pattern.

backlog.title: Keep 9px captions and headings in the skeleton?
backlog.detail: Hold caption, dock caption and table heading are 9px "below the floor by the owner's round-5 ruling"; gate also flags two hold faces. Round 5 says revisit README rules for both tasks.
options: Keep 9px (match farrowing)
Raise to 10-11px in both tasks
backlog.recommendation: Raise to 11px for both: gloved, night-time use.

backlog.title: Farrowing does not run on the skeleton it defines
backlog.detail: Farrowing uses hand-rolled classes (sentri-components.js); only piglet processing uses Task parts. Parity is checked by pixel comparison only, and gate shows two implementations for sheet and page.

backlog.title: Pattern says dock, lens tabs, unit card; processing lacks all three
backlog.detail: The two listed screens differ: no dock, chips instead of tabs, a job card instead of a unit figure. The pattern note describes one screen, not its permitted variations.

backlog.title: TaskSheet and Sheet draw the same drawer twice
backlog.detail: Sheet (.sheet, farrowing and inspection) and TaskSheet/TaskPage (.tk-*) differ in gutters, heights and close rules. Owner rule: one implementation per job.

backlog.title: TaskWarning and Banner do one job with two looks
backlog.detail: Banner danger (14/700 headline) and TaskWarning red (12/700 title), plus Home's offline banner, are three look-alikes of one consequence-above-commit pattern.

backlog.title: TaskRow and Row are two row families
backlog.detail: Row's candidates have no screen; TaskRow and TaskDay serve every real task screen. Farrowing's .sow-row is a further look-alike.

backlog.title: Status chips are built outside the Status component
backlog.detail: To do, Done, Late, Active and Sow died chips are hand-built (.tk-chip, .state-word) rather than Status; "Due tomorrow" is not defined as a forecast.

backlog.title: Full-bleed status bar kept at phone width: unconfirmed
backlog.detail: ADR open question 6: the demo status bar stays on a phone-width window; a real phone has its own. Pending owner nod.

backlog.title: Eight of ten task types are Figma placeholders
backlog.detail: Breeding, heat check, post-farrowing, weaning, pregnancy, return heat, end nursery and end finishing have no design; the section promise "all tasks look the same" is tested on two.

backlog.title: Task skeleton assumes pen grouping; other tasks may group otherwise
backlog.detail: Section copy says rows are grouped by pen. Weaning, heat check and finishing may group by batch, sow or room. Say what the skeleton permits and what a new task must decide.

backlog.title: Every Button and IconButton variant specimen page styles its example separator with…

Every Button and IconButton variant specimen page styles its example separator with var(--space-1), a token tokens.css does not define (the separator silently drops).
Fix: Replace var(--space-1) with var(--border-width) in variants/*.html.

Sheets show both a header close (X) and a footer Back that do the same thing (Farrowing finish, Piglet pen sheet) - the same act offered twice.
Fix: Keep one return per sheet: footer Back where a footer exists, else the X; or record the pair as the rule in Sheet.

Variant specimen pages use undefined var(--space-1) for separators.
Fix: Use var(--border-width).

backlog.title: In use the Standard glyph is drawn at 1.6, 1.7, 1.8 and 2 on the same screen (farrowing.room,…
backlog.detail:
In use the Standard glyph is drawn at 1.6, 1.7, 1.8 and 2 on the same screen (farrowing.room, inspection.walk): raw stroke-width in task-skeleton.css (.tk-summary-heading 1.7, .tk-warning-* 1.8, .tk-dock-unit 1.8, .tk-receipt-mark 2), astra-task-overview.css .tc-heading 1.7, inspection/farrowing .section-title 1.7, piglet-processing simple/app.css .sp-more 2.4 / .sp-give-scan 1.8. Pre-existing, not from this PR.
Fix: Replace those raw stroke-width values with var(--icon-stroke) (or --icon-key-stroke where a heavier key is meant); add a css-vars test that bans raw stroke-width on svg rules.

farrowing.overview: 'Whole-task progress' is 36px above its panel because .task-progress-section is a flex column with gap 24px on top of space-heading 12px; it is also the one section heading there without an icon (Choose a unit and Performance metrics have one).

verification.md still names branch 45-row and predates the tick/select-door proofs.

In the specimens the second heading (Pen) sits about 8px under the Facts panel and about 20px above its own Row group, so it reads as belonging to the block above.

backlog.title: Summary/hero cards beside Panels still carry a faint shadow (tk-summary, task-context-card,…
backlog.detail:

backlog.title: The main pig profile is not on Facts: pig-profile.full 'General details' and 'Sow cycle' are…
backlog.detail:
The main pig profile is not on Facts: pig-profile.full 'General details' and 'Sow cycle' are hand-built grids (.overview-details-grid / .overview-fact) in a panel, same job and look. General details also prints 'Health —' under a banner that says 'Health · Thin', so the screen says health twice and disagrees.
Fix: Render both blocks with SentriUI.facts (Weight and Temperature trails as meta) and drop the Health row; the banner owns health.

The Death breakdown sheet (farrowing-astra-concept.js:423) is a hand-built dl with raw CSS (#f6f7f2, 9px/14px) for read-only label and value pairs. It is one surface in a sheet, not card-on-card, so it is Facts' job.
Fix: Draw it with SentriUI.facts (one fact per cause plus 'Total dead'); no panel-less Facts variant is needed.

columns:1 is still in bundle.js with no screen.

The builder was right to leave them out of Facts: Born · Alive now · Piglet deaths and 7 · 2 · 9 are headline figures inside a metrics card or progress panel, and Facts would put a panel in a panel. Their hand-built dl copies (.task-performance-totals inside task-death-review, .finish-totals) should come from TaskMetrics totals and TaskTotals instead.
