backlog.title: Atlas cascade Active demo passes path [Antibiotics, Penicillins], so the trigger reads…
backlog.detail:
Atlas cascade Active demo passes path [Antibiotics, Penicillins], so the trigger reads "Antibiotics › Penicillins" and never names the chosen Amoxicillin; the real medicine trigger reads category › medicine.
Fix: variants/cascade.html state-Active: path ["Penicillins","Amoxicillin"] (or whatever pickerField needs to end on the leaf).

backlog.title: Reconcile warning title says 'The reported count will replace 9', but the well is labelled…
backlog.detail:
Reconcile warning title says 'The reported count will replace 9', but the well is labelled 'Count the piglets in this litter'; the word 'reported' no longer names anything on screen.
Fix: Title the warning 'Your count will replace 9'.

backlog.title: Focus state still rings both keys (Decrease by forced outline, Increase by real focus), and…
backlog.detail:
Focus state still rings both keys (Decrease by forced outline, Increase by real focus), and Pressed + reads like the grey floor/ceiling key in the Overview.
Fix: Ring one key in Focus; give Pressed a fill distinct from aria-disabled.

backlog.title: Overview clips the focus ring of the Increase key at the column's right edge.
backlog.detail:
Overview clips the focus ring of the Increase key at the column's right edge.
Fix: Give the Overview column 4px inline padding (or overflow: visible).

backlog.title: Well usedBy lists fostering.piglets (no prototype URL) and omits the two farrowing sheets that…
backlog.detail:
Well usedBy lists fostering.piglets (no prototype URL) and omits the two farrowing sheets that actually render the well.
Fix: Add the farrowing foster and reconcile screens to atlas screens and to usedBy.

backlog.title: Give IDs builds the ear-tag field as a Measure with no unit and marks a duplicate tag "refused",…
backlog.detail:
Give IDs builds the ear-tag field as a Measure with no unit and marks a duplicate tag "refused", breaking both the Measure rule (no unit = not a Measure) and the Numpad rule (a duplicate tag warns and records).
Fix: Either add an "identifier" variant to Measure (mono, no unit, warn-only tone) and document it, or render the tag as the Numpad readout; switch the duplicate to tone "warn".

backlog.title: The weight sheet says the unit twice: label "Weight (kg)" over a box that writes "kg".
backlog.detail:
The weight sheet says the unit twice: label "Weight (kg)" over a box that writes "kg".
Fix: Label the field "Litter weight" (or "Weight") and keep the unit only in the box; add a README line: the label never carries the unit.

backlog.title: An optional Measure renders as a full 62px field ("Weight · Optional" on Give IDs), while the…
backlog.detail:
An optional Measure renders as a full 62px field ("Weight · Optional" on Give IDs), while the optional-input rule and farrowing use a collapsed "+ Litter weight" row.
Fix: Add a collapsed optional state: one row of label + "Optional" + an Add door, expanding to the box on tap (match the Photos header row).

backlog.title: CSS uses raw px for borders, gaps and the unit gap, and the README lists no CSS variables.
backlog.detail:
CSS uses raw px for borders, gaps and the unit gap, and the README lists no CSS variables.
Fix: Map 1/2/3/6/8px to existing tokens (caret-width, status-dot, space-key-gap) and add a CSS-variables list to the README.

backlog.title: No label-length rule or long-label example; zh labels are untested in the preview.
backlog.detail:
No label-length rule or long-label example; zh labels are untested in the preview.
Fix: State a label cap and add one long en and one zh label to the preview.

backlog.title: New variant: Measure · identifier (tag)?
backlog.detail:
Give IDs needs a pad-set mono value with no unit and a warn-only duplicate tone; today it is a Measure that breaks its own rules
Seen in: piglet-processing.give-ids

backlog.title: New variant: Measure · optional row (collapsed)?
backlog.detail:
Optional values (litter weight, piglet weight) should be one row until opened, like Photos and farrowing's + Litter weight
Seen in: piglet-processing.give-ids, farrowing.leave-edit

backlog.title: The run variant with the three-line list has no atlas screen, while the compact variant every…
backlog.detail:
The run variant with the three-line list has no atlas screen, while the compact variant every screen uses (weight sheet, Give IDs) is missing from the preview.
Fix: Add compact examples (empty, typing, warn) to preview.html; mark the run variant unused or drop it until a screen needs it.

backlog.title: Status-line text actions ("Use 000258") measure 86x44, under the 48px glove floor.
backlog.detail:
Status-line text actions ("Use 000258") measure 86x44, under the 48px glove floor.
Fix: Give .st-text-action min-height: var(--control-height) inside the pad's status line, and reserve 48px for the line.

backlog.title: Floor-gray keys can be told apart only by colour until tapped.
backlog.detail:
Floor-gray keys can be told apart only by colour until tapped.
Fix: Keep the colour but also drop the key border (a shape change), as Photos does for its inactive camera.

backlog.title: Raw px in CSS and no CSS-variable list.
backlog.detail:
Raw px in CSS and no CSS-variable list.
Fix: Map to space-key-gap / caret-width tokens and list the variables in the README.

backlog.title: Done pen cell aria-label reads "Pen B3, 23 born": with the check (aria-label Done) gone, the…
backlog.detail:
Done pen cell aria-label reads "Pen B3, 23 born": with the check (aria-label Done) gone, the Done state is not named for a screen reader.
Fix: Label done cells "Pen B3, Done, 23 born" in farrowing-astra-concept.js roomGrid.

backlog.title: Home overdue state verified in the card model and DOM text ("Batch 28 · farrowing window · 2…
backlog.detail:
Home overdue state verified in the card model and DOM text ("Batch 28 · farrowing window · 2 days"), not on a rendered bare screen: no atlas screen shows an overdue task card.
Fix: Add an atlas screen for task-cards state=overdue so the overdue card is judged in use.

backlog.title: The attention row keeps one raw amber background (#fcf4e5, inspection-astra-concept.css:651) for…
backlog.detail:
The attention row keeps one raw amber background (#fcf4e5, inspection-astra-concept.css:651) for every care level: outside the tokens, and it tints rows the Mark already colours.
Fix: Give .attention-row a neutral token background (var(--surface) or var(--well)) and let the Mark carry the care colour.

backlog.title: Notice zh cell says waiting-to-upload twice: headline ends 等待网络连接后再上传 and the consequence…
backlog.detail:
Notice zh cell says waiting-to-upload twice: headline ends 等待网络连接后再上传 and the consequence repeats 等待上传.
Fix: Shorten the consequence to 无网络连接 (keep the headline over the cap).

backlog.title: piglet-processing.pen-list: the screen subtitle 'Last record 08:40 · L. Madsen' and the banner's…
backlog.detail:
piglet-processing.pen-list: the screen subtitle 'Last record 08:40 · L. Madsen' and the banner's 'by L. Madsen at 08:40' say the same who/when right above each other (screen budget, not the component).
Fix: In the prototype, hide the Last record line while the clash banner shows, or drop the time/name from the banner text.

backlog.title: The shared optionalRow (ux/system/sentri-components.css) still uses raw font weights and…
backlog.detail:
The shared optionalRow (ux/system/sentri-components.css) still uses raw font weights and stroke-width:1.7; Photos inherits them. Belongs to the optional row, not Photos.
Fix: When OptionalRow gets its own page, move its weights to type-weight tokens and its stroke to an icon-stroke token.
